name: match
detail: match pta_alloc_of(kind) { Some(inits) => { let objs = pta_heap_objs(pta_site_of(sites, fi, v), heaps) for obj in objs { if pta_add(pt, pta_bound_name(kind), obj) { changed = true} for pair in inits { let(fld, e) = pair if pta_join(hp, obj +.+ fld, pta_of_expr(pt, hp, e)) { changed = true}}}} None => match kind { Assign(x, e) => if pta_join(pt, x, pta_of_expr(pt, hp, e)) { changed = true} Store(x, e) => if pta_join(pt, x, pta_of_expr(pt, hp, e)) { changed = true} PlaceStore(target, e) => match target.kind { @ast.EField(b, fld) => { let dest = pta_of_expr(pt, hp, b) let src = pta_of_expr(pt, hp, e) for o, _ in dest { if pta_join(hp, o +.+ fld, src) { changed = true}}} @ast.EIndex(b, _) => { let dest = pta_of_expr(pt, hp, b) let src = pta_of_expr(pt, hp, e) for o, _ in dest { if pta_join(hp, o + .arr, src) { changed = true}}} _ =>()} _ =>()}}
